# Final Fantasy Portal App: Triple Triad

## Android (Platform)

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.ffportal_w.googleplay
  - The app page is still live (checked 2026-10-19), and its description no longer mentions Triple Triad (only user reviews do), so the row links the Wayback capture of 2024-09-09 (before the 2024-11-26 closing; its description says "You can play the card game Triple Triad"): https://web.archive.org/web/20240909220125/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.ffportal_w.googleplay
  - In-app games (Wayback captures of the Play page, read by me 2026-10-20): the 2015-09-05 description says you can play Triple Triad "or the original classic FINAL FANTASY (Portal version)"; by 2020-01-15 (and still on 2021-03-08) it adds "FINAL FANTASY II (Portal Version)"
    - Specified in-game apps made specifically to launch from the portal app; not compatible with the non-Portal apps of the same name (the old Final Fantasy and II Android ports say the same)
    - ja.wikipedia: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファイナルファンタジーシリーズの作品一覧#その他の派生作品 (text pasted by user 2026-10-20) -- list entry ファイナルファンタジー ポータルアプリ (iPhone, Android, 2015年2月5日): a smartphone FF information app that delivers FF news; 『FFI』, 『FFII』 and the card game Triple Triad can be played; the app's own article link is red (no ja.wikipedia page)
      - Dates: ja.wikipedia 2015-02-05, en.wikipedia JP 2015-02-04 and WW 2015-08-19, the entry 2015-04-01; unresolved (see the entry's date)
      - en.wikipedia's list entry names Triple Triad only; candidate in docs/wiki-corrections.md
    - Timeline from the Play page captures (read by me 2026-10-20): the 2015-09-05 description names Final Fantasy (Portal version) only; "Final Fantasy II (Portal Version)" is listed by 2020-01-15; both are still listed on 2023-12-11 and gone from the capture of 2024-01-06 (updated Dec 12, 2023), whose description names Triple Triad only (it closed 2024-11-26)
    - Standalone Android pages: Final Fantasy first captured 2012-12-09, II on 2013-01-30; Final Fantasy was updated 2015-02-26 (three weeks after the Portal App's 2015-02-05 launch) and its description carries the "not compatible with Final Fantasy (Portal Version)" note by 2015-09; the II page shows version 4.0 (2014-01-06) without the note in 2015 and the note by 2020 (version 6.2, 2020-03-27)
    - Which edition the Portal Versions ran is not stated anywhere found; the standalone Android versions are our Final Fantasy "Remaster 2012" and Final Fantasy II "Edit 2012" (data) 
    - The entry covers Triple Triad only; whether the Portal versions need an entry or a mention is open
    - Checked by the user 2026-10-20, none mentions the Portal Versions: the Final Fantasy Wiki pages Final_Fantasy_version_differences and Final_Fantasy_II_version_differences, the wiki's Final_Fantasy_Portal_App page (Triple Triad only), and en.wikipedia's list entry (released JP 2015-02-04, WW 2015-08-19, Android and iOS, "contains the Triple Triad card game from Final Fantasy VIII"; no dedicated page)
    - Capture of 2020-12-02 (page text pasted by user): version 2.1.3, updated March 23, 2020, 7,964 ratings (3.3 stars), 500,000+ installs, in-app purchases of $0.99 to $19.99; "a general portal app for information on FINAL FANTASY and related products" with news, a points system for wallpapers and other digital content, and the in-app games Triple Triad, FINAL FANTASY (Portal Version) and FINAL FANTASY II (Portal Version)
